notes: IEEE 802.3df does not specify on-chip calibration loops; the PHY digital (MAC/RS/PCS) is verified by testbench, while the PAM4 analog (SerDes, optics) requires per-PMD compliance lab tests (TDECQ, eye, return loss, OMA, BER) per the relevant 800GBASE PMD clause. The RS-FEC counters provide the primary in-system margin instrument.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PAM4 transmitter eye / TDECQ
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Per-lane PAM4 transmitter compliance (TDECQ for optical; eye + return loss for electrical 800GAUI) at 106.25 GBd.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Post-FEC BER
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify <=1e-13 post-FEC over the compliance channel using the RS-FEC(544,514) corrected/uncorrected counters.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Pre-FEC raw-lane BER margin
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure per-lane raw error ratio (~1e-4..1e-5) against the FEC budget.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: RS-FEC symbol-error distribution
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Per-lane corrected-symbol histogram to localise a weak lane.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Inter-lane skew + deskew margin
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the PCS deskew FIFOs absorb the worst-case medium skew.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PMD optical power / OMA (per variant)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: DR8/SR8/VR8/2xFR4 transmitter optical modulation amplitude + extinction ratio.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Link-training convergence time
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify FFE/DFE adapt within the training timer on each lane.
